subject.title: WebChat: a config-change gateway restart drops the in-flight turn (empty/failed session, recovery can't resume, no user notice)

question: Should this issue be resolved by the scoped transcript-notice fallback in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/95154, or should maintainers require a broader restart-deferral/immediate-user-persistence fix before closure?
rationale: The reporter allowed either wait/resume or notify, and the linked PR fixes the no-notice branch without guaranteeing the original in-flight user turn is preserved or resumed.

options.title: Land scoped notice fallback
options.body: Rebase and review the linked PR as the narrow fix so WebChat users see the existing interruption notice instead of a blank failed session.

options.title: Require durable resume semantics
options.body: Hold closure until the runtime persists the inbound user message or reliably defers restart so the interrupted turn can resume without retyping.

options.title: Split broader policy follow-up
options.body: Accept the notice fix for this issue and track stronger recover-and-continue or restart-deferral semantics in a separate canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Land scoped notice fallback
recommendation.body: Rebase and review the linked PR as the narrow fix so WebChat users see the existing interruption notice instead of a blank failed session.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans delivery-mirror transcript behavior and restart deferral, both of which show prior history under this owner signal.
